decision: No change to v19 3-RTH-hour check, thresholds, fees, emergency stop or 52 RTHh horizon
data_observation: KLAC 15m source complete across the original study year; 5m Terminal source missing 7 expected 5m observation slots across 2025 Oct/Dec
treatment: Never invent or forward-fill missing 5m candles. Compute all expected 5m timestamps from 15m source; if a candidate trade entry-to-either-possible-exit path intersects ANY source-missing candle, report right/data-censored (unknown) and exclude from resolved paired returns and bootstrap. Retain it in the original opportunity denominator.
benchmark: Both branches use same frozen 3H parent turn entry, identical 1.5% hard stop, 25% partial at +2%, 5bp cost each side, 52 RTH-hour expiration; guard at completed three-hour 5m close below entry, exits next 5m open
validation: All complete triplets of 5m bars must match the 15m source OHLC; volume differences explicitly recorded. Number of source missing slots, affected outcomes and remaining trades reported unconditionally.
publication: Research-only aggregate, no raw historical prices and no adjustment or PIT validation.
